assessments.reasoning: Sections 7.1 and 7.4.1 distinguish public declarations used for type matching from runtime interface records filled with references by the binder. The PROGRAM imports example names records separately from the associated definitions modules acting as interface types.

challenge.method: Compare an explicit record name and type with the implicit-name case, then inspect the example with two runtime records for one definitions type.
challenge.results: A definitions module can support static type checking without attaching live references. One type admits multiple named records, and a shorthand can derive a record name from the type name. These cases fit the proposed scope of a named interface record.

limitations: This claim applies to the documented import and binding mechanism. It supplies no exact binding time, layout, implementation compatibility or automatically bound instance.
